features: Multiple Sizes: Available in three sizes—18mm, 20mm, and 22mm—for a comfortable fit.
Prayer Reminders: Provides 2 to 5 daily prayer reminders to help maintain your prayer schedule.
Tasbih Counting: Features a smart Tasbih counter with up to 3 Tasbih reminders for daily Dhikr.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Syncs with the Smart Qibla Life App for easy management of reminders and settings.
Smart Qibla Life App: Allows customization of prayer and Tasbih reminders, tracking progress, and personalizing ring settings.
Elegant Design: Combines traditional Islamic practices with modern technology in a sleek design.
